team_name: New Zealand National Football Team (All Whites)

head_coach.name: Darren Bazeley
head_coach.play_style_summary: Focuses on building a technical, ball-playing side utilizing a high press and quick transitions. The system aims to control the middle third while using the full-backs to provide width and stretch opponents in the final third.

key_players.name: Chris Wood
key_players.performance_stats: Team captain and all-time leading goalscorer for New Zealand with over 45 international goals, showing clinical finishing form in the English Premier League.

key_players.name: Joe Bell
key_players.performance_stats: A vital midfield engine for Viking FK, acting as the primary hub to break up play and transition the ball effectively.

key_players.name: Tyler Bindon
key_players.performance_stats: A highly-rated young defensive talent who has established himself as a key physical and tactical presence in the defensive unit.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Recovering from a hamstring strain ahead of international fixtures.
